title: Observability Quick-Start: Compact Lens + Traceshot Visuals
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and export a compact set of observability onboarding visuals for the Quick-Start flow: a small 'lens' dashboard card that surfaces 99th/median latency, a cost-per-token waterfall compact card, and a single-column traceshot view for quick investigation. Deliver artifacts for both light and dark themes and produce engineering redlines + accessible color tokens.
assets: Figma: Observability Quickstart > Compact Lens v2 (page) - figma.com/file/obs-compact-lens
comments: 2026-03-01 Ava Chen: Kickoff - sketched 3 variations for lens: numeric-only, sparkline+nums, and sparkline+percentiles. Prefer the sparkline+percentiles for onboarding clarity.
2026-03-03 Marco Silva: Requested smaller font sizes to avoid text-wrapping at 320px narrow embed. Also asked for 1px stroke alternatives for dark mode.
2026-03-05 Product review (Lina Patel): Prefer cost waterfall to show 'cost per token' and 'cache hit' rows. Added request to include tooltip copy for how cost is computed.
2026-03-07 Eng sync (Ravi Kumar): Confirmed metrics endpoints available: /api/v1/metrics/latency?range=1h and /api/v1/metrics/cost?range=1h. Asked for dataset sample in JSON for handoff.
2026-03-09 Design review (Ava): Uploaded initial PNG exports and noted contrast issues with red accent in dark mode; lowered saturation and provided alternative token #E85C4A -> #D9534F.
2026-03-10 Accessibility pass (Maya Ortiz): Ran color contrast; lens numeric values pass WCAG AA at 14px for light mode but failed for dark mode header. Adjusted header color to #F3F4F6.
2026-03-11 Marco Silva: Prepared engineering redline file and started PR for console assets - https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1984
2026-03-12 PM feedback (Jon Park): Approved visuals; requested microcopy revision for the traceshot tooltip to explicitly mention "span duration" and "resource id".
2026-03-12 Ava Chen: Updated exports with new tooltip copy and uploaded final SVGs to Drive. Marked ready for final engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Three exported visuals (lens, cost waterfall, traceshot) available in Drive in both light and dark variants
All numeric values and sparkline components scale correctly at 320px, 640px, and 1200px widths
Color tokens documented and WCAG AA contrast confirmed for text at 14px
Engineering redlines and Figma link provided; PR opened referencing this ticket
Tooltip copy and microcopy approved by PM and included in exported assets
design_decisions: Chose sparkline + percentile badges for the lens to provide immediate trend context without requiring a full chart
Compact cost waterfall uses stacked mini-bars (4 bins) rather than full time-series to keep quickstart card lightweight
Traceshot is a single-column condensed span list rather than full swimlane to reduce cognitive load for new users
Dark mode colors lean slightly desaturated to preserve emphasis while improving contrast on OLED displays
export_instructions: Lens: export PNG @2x (2400x1600 source) and SVG for scalable embeds; provide 320px and 640px optimized slices
Cost waterfall: export as SVG and 1200px PNG; include separate layers for bars and labels in Figma for animation hooks
Traceshot: PNG @2x and a JSON mock dataset example (traceshot_sample.json) for engineering: include span_id, duration_ms, service, resource
Include source Figma file and a flattened redline PDF for the design-dev handoff
engineering_notes: Use /api/v1/metrics/latency?window=1h to populate lens percentile badges (p50,p90,p99). Backend will return {p50: 24, p90: 110, p99: 320} in ms
Cost-per-token tile should compute cost using /api/v1/metrics/cost?window=1h and attach 'cache_hit' boolean to each sample for visual annotation
Traceshot will be wired to /api/v1/traces/quickshot?limit=10 and should accept 'compact=true' to deliver condensed span fields
Animation hooks: expose sparkline path as #sparkline-path and tooltip regions as data-span-id attributes for the console renderer
